article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post (captured 2011-06-04, listed as posted 1 year 5 months before capture, so roughly late 2009 or early 2010) about player housing. It says every new account gets a free apartment, members also receive a house, and players can decorate interiors and exteriors with furniture, statues and blocks, buying items with game coins or the Station Cash catalog. It also promises holiday décor arriving in the following weeks through late January.
